name: aot-evals
description: Part of AOT, the Agent Optimization Toolkit, a Mahal Systems offering. Build and iterate the evals for a production agent in three phases: Assess (a discovery report), Build (the agent wired up, cases from real runs, a baseline) and Judge (a local grader application where the people who know what good looks like label runs and the suite is held to them). A stdlib CLI records every attempt, and a fixed report.json schema renders into a local HTML diagnostic.
